errors.evidence: The legend for the solid line reads "30个模型分别对应的FP" which translates to "FP corresponding to each of the 30 models". The description incorrectly interprets "分别" (respectively/individually) as "分割" (segmentation).

The description introduces an unsubstantiated interpretation of the abbreviation "FP" as "Function Point". In the context of model evaluation, FP more commonly stands for False Positives. This interpretation is not supported by the figure.
The x-axis shows major tick marks at intervals of 5 (1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30), not 1.
The description states the solid line is marked with dots, but the figure shows a continuous solid line with no point markers.
The starting value of the solid line at x=1 is clearly above 2500, approximately 2650. A value of 2000 is incorrect.

errors.text_span: 在 x 轴 12 和 18 处达到高峰
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies peaks at x=12 and x=18. The value at x=18 is in a trough, not a peak. The highest peak in the chart is at x=20.

errors.text_span: 在 x 轴 25 处达到最小值
errors.evidence: The absolute minimum value of the solid line occurs at x=13, where the line drops to just above 2000. The value at x=25 is a local minimum, but not the overall minimum for the series.
The dashed line spans the entire width of the plot, same as the solid line, so it is not 'shorter'. Additionally, the line is gray, not 'brown'.
The legend for the dashed line is "投票得到的FP" (FP obtained by voting), not a generic "reference FP threshold". This misrepresents the provided legend information.

errors.text_span: 在整个范围内保持在 2000 左右
errors.evidence: The dashed horizontal line is positioned visibly above the 2000 grid line, at approximately 2150. Stating it is 'around 2000' is inaccurate.
